subject: Enclave fork and term reprice — coordination and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medtechlabs.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 17:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: new isolated enclave + renewal term options

Hi Jonas,

We're approaching our Redwood renewal window (Feb 2027) and have a new compliance requirement that forces a portion of our workload into a strictly isolated on-prem environment. We want to discuss spinning up a separate enclave (physically isolated cluster) for our EU clinical analytics pipelines, plus a longer-term commitment to cover the extra infra cost.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood support a new on-prem enclave (airgapped or VPC-coupled) with separate clusters and tenant separation?
- Rough sizing guidance & lead time for deployment (we're targeting Q1 provisioning).
- Pricing impact for adding 3 clusters and moving the analytics tenant into the isolated environment; interested in 24-month and 36-month term pricing.
- Any SOC 2 / evidence we should attach for our audit team.

I've looped in procurement. Happy to set a call this week for a quick discovery — we can share current throughput numbers then.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Infrastructure, MedTech Labs
+39 345 555 0102

Attachment: SOC2-readiness-questions.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: new isolated enclave + renewal term options

Hi Elena,

Thanks — we can definitely support an isolated enclave approach. Before we commit a sizing/price path I want to confirm a few things so Marissa and I can put together a concrete proposal:

1) Expected steady-state QPS and p50/p95 token latency targets for the analytics tenant (rough order of magnitude is fine).
2) Is the enclave required to be airgapped, or is a dedicated VPC with no cross-tenant routing acceptable?
3) Any encryption/KMS policies and preferred key management (customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed)?
4) Do you expect burst windows (daily/weekend jobs) that materially exceed the baseline?

If you have a preferred time for a 30–45m discovery, propose slots and we'll book. Priyom — can you draft term/discount options once we have sizing? Marissa — can you start a sizing worksheet based on a 3-cluster baseline (analytics + standby + ingress)?

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechlabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: new isolated enclave + renewal term options — sizing & lead times

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the context — ran a quick sizing pass and sketched options. Attaching the worksheet and a private-deploy checklist so your infra team can validate host/security constraints. High-level summary below.

Recommended baseline (on-prem enclave):
- Primary analytics cluster: 3x A100-ish nodes (or equivalent), 24GB model memory per node; expected steady-state 1200 QPS for small prompts, ~p95 latency 120–160ms with batching.
- Standby cluster: 1–2 nodes for failover (cold start mitigation).
- Ingress/proxy nodes (dedicated): 2 nodes for traffic buffering and TLS termination.
- Storage & KV: separate encrypted storage behind customer-managed KMS.

Lead times and constraints:
- On-prem hardware procurement + integration: ~5–7 weeks after signed SOW + provisioning checklist complete.
- Private VPC (cloud-hosted dedicated): ~10 business days if using our Dedicated pools in-region (faster option vs. full on-prem).

Operational notes:
- We recommend a rollout in two phases: (A) dedicated VPC staging to validate traffic patterns, (B) cutover to airgapped enclave if required. This minimizes risk and shortens time to value.

Attachments:
- medtech-enclave-sizing.xlsx (spreadsheet, 98KB)
- priv-deploy-checklist.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

I'll follow up with a capacity-cost estimate once Priyom shares target term and expected commit.

Cheers,
Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medtechlabs.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: new isolated enclave + renewal term options — sizing & lead times

Thanks Marissa — that level of detail is helpful. A few follow-ups from procurement and security:

- Procurement: Can you provide an updated quote with (a) 12-month, (b) 24-month, and (c) 36-month term pricing for the baseline above (3 clusters + ingress + standby)? We also need clearly called out SLA and credit terms.
- Security: We will require SOC 2 artifacts and a short list of hardening steps for the airgapped option; Marissa's checklist helps but our auditors want formal evidence.

Also, if you have any standard term amendments or an annex for isolated environments (e.g., data residency, support hours), please send them along. We aim to decide on commitment length by mid-December.

Elena

Attachment: SOC2-readiness-questions.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtechlabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@medtechlabs.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: new isolated enclave + renewal term options — quote & terms

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Based on Marissa's sizing, attaching a draft quote for the baseline enclave and three term buckets. High-level commercials:

- 12m: list price (no commit): base recurring + one-time integration fee.
- 24m: 15% volume discount across infra and support for a 24-month commitment; includes expedited provisioning SLA and 16h/week of onboarding support.
- 36m: 20% discount + prioritized capacity reservations and a 99.9% additional uptime SLA credit threshold.

I've included a draft SOW language and an amendment that lists isolation controls and data residency obligations. Deal: RDW-7591-ML.

Attachments:
- RDW-7591-ML-quote-v2.pdf (PDF, 74KB)

Links:

1) Elena/procurement — review the quote and confirm preferred term (24m preferred if you want the 15% discount).
2) If SOC 2 artifacts are required, I'll loop security to provide the security pack and an exec summary.

Thanks,
Priyom
